scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @quiz/contracts && concurrently -k -n server,web "npm run dev --workspace @quiz/server" "npm run dev --workspace @quiz/web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @quiz/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @quiz/web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspace @quiz/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @quiz/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @quiz/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.teacher:seed-demo: npm run build --workspace @quiz/contracts && npm run teacher:seed-demo --workspace @quiz/server
